title: The new Elf could tap immediately
era: 1994 World Championship using modern haste keyword
story: The first Forest cast my Llanowar Elves during my main phase, and the new Elf could not yet tap for mana. I tapped my second Forest to cast Concordant Crossroads for one green. The enchantment resolved; it gave every creature haste, including the Elf I had just played. I tapped that Elf for one green mana, leaving both lands tapped. My opponent's Kird Ape would receive haste too if it entered on their next turn, so passing without using the extra mana had a real cost. The enchantment did not create another land drop.
review: Two Forests each produce green for Elves and Crossroads. Newly controlled Elf obtains haste and may tap for {G} on the same turn; Crossroads symmetric. Opposing Kird Ape is fictional.
